newsitem.title: UK: RUGBY UNION-BOOKMAKERS UNIMPRESSED BY LIONS WIN.
newsitem.headline: RUGBY UNION-BOOKMAKERS UNIMPRESSED BY LIONS WIN.

text.p: British bookmakers made South Africa even firmer favourites to win the forthcoming test series following the British Lions unimpressive 18-14 win over Border in East London on Wednesday.
Bookmakers William Hill shortened the odds on South Africa winning the three-match test series to 1-6 from 1-5 with the Lions being quoted at 7-2 from 3-1.

"Today's performance against arguably the weakest team they will play on tour does not augur well for the Lions against the stronger provincial sides let alone the full Springbok test side," said William Hill's spokesman Dave Brown.
